sections.title: Two useful set phrases
sections.content: Beyond naming individual days, Hungarian has ready-made words for the two halves of the week: hétköznap ("weekday", Monday to Friday) and hétvége ("weekend"). hétköznap works as an adverb all by itself — no suffix needed, just like vasárnap. hétvége needs -n like any other noun: hétvégén, "on the weekend".

items.english: On weekdays I work, on the weekend I don't.

sections.content: munkanap ("workday") and szabadnap ("day off") are the same kind of compound as hétvége — hét ("week") + vég ("end"), munka ("work") + nap ("day"), szabad ("free") + nap ("day"). Recognizing nap ("day") inside a longer word is a shortcut to guessing what it means.
